scope: One bounded same-instance Chisel witness derives the C2 packed-read handle from a successful R3 packed durable write and reads the exact eight-fragment object through two independently reset testbench functional-memory endpoints sharing only host-side object contents.

boundary.object_key: testbench-only (opaque address_ref, existing expected_fragment_count); not a deployed physical address format
boundary.publication_endpoint: testbench_route_a_functional_memory_environment bound at the real R3/R5 R1 external port
boundary.source_endpoint: testbench_route_a_functional_memory_environment bound at the C2 source-read R1 external port
boundary.continuity_rule: C2 descriptor payload handle is the accepted R3 eight-fragment packed-write address_ref; both endpoints use the same testbench-only object store
boundary.unclosed: C2 grants remain verification facts; C1 sidecar and RTL3.6-B/R4 static fixtures remain; no terminal-release/global-drain closure

invariants: one successful R3 eight-fragment packed write materializes only at its accepted terminal
C2 reads the exact R3 durable payload object rather than an independently injected payload
a one-fragment descriptor object cannot overwrite an eight-fragment payload object at the same opaque address_ref in the testbench store
payload and descriptor functional objects are selected by existing R1 expected-fragment cardinality only
no production common-memory/controller or physical-address claim
no ownership, authority, publication, scheduler, or atomic-commit semantic change

chisel_commands: cd hardware/route_a/chisel && env JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64 sbt -batch 'testOnly kvpress.routea.rtl2.RouteARTL265eSameInstanceWitnessSpec -- -z "reads the exact R3-durable"'
